title: Dataset Version Content Identity Response
description: GET /api/v1/datasets/{dataset_id}/versions/{version_id}/content-identity. Success envelope (response_handler.success_response): {success, message, data} where data is HostedDatasetVersionContentIdentityV1 -- the Backend's SERVER-COMPUTED content identity of one hosted dataset version (docs/identity/content-identity-v1.md sections 4.4, 4.5 and 5; TraigentBackend src/services/content_identity/hosted_dataset_identity.py HostedDatasetIdentityView.to_wire / unavailable_wire, route src/routes/dataset_version_routes.py get_dataset_version_content_identity). It is served by its own sub-resource so DatasetVersionV1 (dataset_version_schema.json, a closed contract) is unchanged. It is NOT a DatasetIdentityV1 record: it carries no record_state, adds the per-example map (examples) and the member-list provenance (members_source), and inlines no members; a relying party rebuilds the multiset from examples (count = occurrences of each (example_id, example_version) pair) and MUST recompute dataset_root from it. Every string pattern in this file ends with the portable end anchor (?![\s\S]) instead of $ (see content_identity_v1_schema.json).

HostedContentIdentityUnavailableReasonV1.description: Closed vocabulary of why a hosted dataset version has no servable content identity on this read. Content-free by construction. legacy_version_without_snapshot: the version was minted before content_snapshot existed, so nothing can be computed. not_yet_computed: no identity row exists under the tenant's ACTIVE key id -- custody not configured, a mint that failed (the mint-time reason is logged, not stored), or a key rotated since the mint; scripts/maintenance/backfill_dataset_version_roots.py mints it later where possible. stored_identity_mismatch: a stored identity no longer recomputes (its per-example map, counts, member list or version binding drifted); it is refused, never served.

HostedExampleIdentityV1.description: One hosted example row of the version's content_snapshot and the identifiers the Backend minted for it under the tenant key. Rows that share content share example_id/example_version and are counted, not collapsed.

example_uuid.description: The hosted example row id (content_snapshot[].example_id / DatasetVersionV1.example_ids member). A Backend row id, NOT a content identifier.

public_input_digest.description: OPT-IN, UNKEYED exu1 digest of the example's input. Present ONLY while the parent dataset's public_benchmark flag is set (ruling D3; PUT /api/v1/datasets/{dataset_id}/public-benchmark); never stored, computed per read from the snapshot. Absent in every other case, including on every other dataset read surface.

key_id.description: The tenant's ACTIVE key id at read time. The identity is served only for the active key.

distinct_count.description: Number of distinct (example_id, example_version) leaves: the Merkle tree size.

total_count.description: Number of snapshot rows, duplicates included (equals the length of examples).

members_ref.description: Tenant-scoped handle of the stored member list whose root is dataset_root. No public route resolves it yet; the examples map is sufficient to recompute the root.

members_source.description: Provenance of the member list: computed by the Backend from the version's own content_snapshot, never accepted from a client.

examples.description: One entry per snapshot row, sorted ascending by example_uuid.

dataset_version_id.description: The DatasetVersionV1.id this identity belongs to (the version_id path parameter).

dataset_id.description: The parent dataset (the dataset_id path parameter).

HostedDatasetVersionContentIdentityV1.description: Either the verified identity (status available) or why there is none (status unavailable). Never a guessed or partial identity.

x-backend-obligations: Every example_id, example_version and the dataset_root carry key_id as their second colon-separated field.

The multiset built from examples (count = occurrences of each (example_id, example_version) pair) recomputes to dataset_root, distinct_count, total_count and conflicting_example_ids; a stored identity that does not is answered status unavailable, reason stored_identity_mismatch.
public_input_digest is emitted only while the parent dataset's public_benchmark flag is set, and on no other read surface.
The version is loaded through the owner-scoped parent dataset; a version the caller cannot read is 404, never an identity.
